title.zh: 采样与混叠 · 偷看得太懒，就会看错
title.en: Sampling & Aliasing · Peek Too Lazily and You'll See It Wrong

desc.zh: 车轮在视频里为什么会倒转？采样就是每隔一会儿偷看世界一眼——看得太懒，眼睛会连出一波根本不存在的假信号。奈奎斯特的那条线、44.1 kHz 的由来，都在这里亲手玩明白。
desc.en: Why do wheels spin backwards on video? Sampling is peeking at the world every so often — peek too lazily and your eyes will invent a signal that was never there. Play with the Nyquist line and the origin of 44.1 kHz until they click.
